name: Child support by state (OCSE): collections, cases, orders and arrears, fiscal years 2021 to 2025
description: The Office of Child Support Enforcement's preliminary data tables for the nation, every state, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, five federal fiscal years: child support collections distributed, cases open, cases with a support order, paternities established, current support due and distributed, arrears due, children in cases and OCSE's cost-effectiveness ratio. Two shares are computed from OCSE's own counts.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Child support by state (OCSE): collections, cases, orders and arrears, fiscal years 2021 to 2025 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24011319

distribution.name: child-support.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: child-support.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: child-support
recordSet.description: The records of Child support by state (OCSE): collections, cases, orders and arrears, fiscal years 2021 to 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US

field.name: level
field.description: us or state (every state, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands)

field.name: area
field.description: US, or the 2-digit state FIPS code

field.name: areaName
field.description: Jurisdiction name

field.name: stateName
field.description: Jurisdiction name

field.name: status
field.description: P: OCSE's own preliminary tables

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Dollars of current support distributed per 100 dollars due in the latest fiscal year (the same as current_paid_per_100_due_latest)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: Latest federal fiscal year in the file (October to September)

field.name: firstYear
field.description: First fiscal year in the file for this jurisdiction

field.name: collections_usd_latest
field.description: Child support collections distributed, in US dollars (Table P-4)

field.name: cases_open_latest
field.description: Cases open at the end of the fiscal year (Table P-53)

field.name: cases_orders_latest
field.description: Cases with a support order established (Table P-64)

field.name: paternities_latest
field.description: Paternities established or acknowledged (Table P-71)

field.name: cases_collection_latest
field.description: Cases in which a collection was made on an obligation (Table P-75)

field.name: current_due_usd_latest
field.description: Current support due in the fiscal year, in US dollars (Table P-83)

field.name: current_paid_usd_latest
field.description: Support distributed as current support, in US dollars (Table P-84)

field.name: arrears_due_usd_latest
field.description: Arrears due for all fiscal years, in US dollars (Table P-85)

field.name: cases_arrears_latest
field.description: Cases with arrears due (Table P-87)

field.name: children_latest
field.description: Children in child support cases (Table P-93)

field.name: cost_effectiveness_latest
field.description: OCSE's cost-effectiveness ratio: dollars collected per dollar spent (Table P-36)

field.name: orders_per_100_open_latest
field.description: Computed here: cases with a support order per 100 cases open

field.name: current_paid_per_100_due_latest
field.description: Computed here: dollars of current support distributed per 100 dollars due

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the first fiscal year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the latest fiscal year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the file was last re-read from OCSE

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
